actor_initialization: fresh residual MLP; random hidden layers, zero output layer, fresh scalar action std 0.25
critic_initialization: fresh random MLP; no source critic weights
critic_normalization_initialization: fresh moments from one pooled initial observation batch; then updated online

dataset.coverage: all recursive *.npz files; no exclusions or active subset

distributed.advantage_normalization: global rollout mean and sample standard deviation
distributed.critic_normalization: global pooled sums, squared sums and count at every environment step
distributed.gradient_synchronization: mean across all ranks at each optimizer step

frozen_inference: cached chunk and long summaries; final short-context attention every control step
frozen_tracker_role: pretrained base action and original 1645-dimensional preprocessing

input_audit.critic_tracker_action_normalization: unmodified raw action; appended after obs compression
input_audit.critic_tracker_action_source: same current raw deterministic tracker mean used by actor; stored in rollout observations

motion_sampling.scope: Uniform motion sampling; independent hand [0,2.5] / shin [0,4] kg or the selected complete fixed DR
motion_sampling.statistics: Uniform throughout; no adaptive curriculum or failure rewind

physics.sampling: Independent hand U(0,2.5) and shin U(0,4) kg per world; fixed at startup

policy_precision_audit.context_inference_autocast: bfloat16 on CUDA; frozen context stored in float32

residual_bounds.semantics: Correction at the same state before physical actuator clipping; not guaranteed delivered torque

resume_contract: restore model optimizer normalizers and update count; restart simulator episodes
stop_contract: finish current update and save; total completed count is authoritative

training_starts.contract: Training reset curriculum only; no changes to physical DR, sensors, motions, terminations, or evaluation
